messages:
Alyssa (Product): quick heads-up — Acme wants guaranteed 99.9 p50 latency for private deploy w/ burst to 500 rps. they requested GA by 2024-12-15. can we align on what we need from runtime/infra/security? cc @Matt (Runtime) @Jordan (Infra) @Sarah (Security)

Matt (Runtime): rough yes but need prewarm + reserved KV cache and model quantization profile. depends on batch size. i estimate 3 weeks for perf tuning if infra provides reserved gpus.

Jordan (Infra): we can reserve 8xA100s in their VPC, but need order of magnitude estimate on pods and expected concurrent KV size. also need network egress plan for cross-region fallback.

Sarah (Security): security review required for customer-managed KMS & audit retention. timeline: 2 weeks for standard review, +1 week if infra changes env. need threat model details.

Alyssa (Product): ack. high-level numbers from customer: 500 sustained rps, p50 <=120ms, p95 <=300ms, 30 sec session KV cache. can we map to infra slots? also rolling canary with automatic fallback to hosted api.

Matt (Runtime): with batching disabled p50 mostly driven by model latency. for 120ms p50 we need model with <=70ms per token and aggressive prefix cache. proposing: reserved capacity pool with 4 replicas hot + 2 warm, prewarm script, model quant to int8.

Jordan (Infra): that maps to ~6 pods on A100 with 48GB each depending on model. network: allow fallback to us-east-hosted via private peering; need PM to sign off on cross-account keys.

Sarah (Security): KMS approval: require key policy doc + key rotation plan. can we avoid customer KMS initially and use Redwood-managed with contract clause? reduces review time.

Alyssa (Product): customer insisted on customer-managed KMS for compliance. request: can security provide expedited review lane (SLA 3 business days) if we provide filled template? Also need launch gates: perf sig-tests, infra smoke, security sign-off.

Matt (Runtime): timeline if expedited: perf tuning 2w, integration 1w, canary 3 days. total ~3.5 weeks.

Jordan (Infra): infra provisioning lead time 4 business days. i'll provision staging footprint tomorrow if we get confirmation. I'll open infra ticket (#INF-4821) with required capacity.

OpsBot (deploy-bot): ticket created: INF-4821 — reserved A100 pool request. ETA: 4 business days. :white_check_mark:

Alyssa (Product): action items:
- Alyssa: confirm SLA and delivery date with Acme by EOD
- Matt: draft perf test config + prewarm script by Tue
- Jordan: provision staging footprint + open peering request
- Sarah: send KMS template + confirm expedited lane

Sarah (Security): will send template in thread, pinging @legal for KMS contract clause review.

Matt (Runtime): note: need to pin model version for rollout, otherwise quant/weights drift will break latency targets. create model-pin PR.

Alyssa (Product): thanks. we'll sync again Monday 10am PT. :calendar:

Jordan (Infra): added to calendar invite.
